messages:
Taylor (eng-runtime): quick follow-up from the Bluestone postmortem — Dedicated + on-prem peering flake. We landed the RCA in the doc but need tracked remediation. High level: VPC peering instability, on‑prem orchestration edge-case, and isolation test gaps. Assigning owners and due dates below.

Samir (eng-sre): I can own the VPC peering stability work. Need packet captures, BGP dumps, and the customer's peering config. ETA ~2w. :thumbsup:

Anna (eng-platform): I'll take the on‑prem orchestration fallback prototype. Plan: sandbox + e2e with short-circuit fallback. Target PR by end of next sprint (2026-04-06).

Diane (customer-success): Customer wants an interim mitigation now — throttle heavy cross-VPC gradients and enable the soft-fallback policy. I'll schedule comms and the maintenance window. Jordan-CS, can you create the maintenance?

deploy-bot: maintenance created by Jordan-CS: "Bluestone peering maintenance" scheduled 2026-04-07T00:00:00Z - 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z (ref: #maintenance-180045).

Taylor (eng-runtime): Action items (tracked in tracker, please link PRs/tickets into comments):
```
- T1: VPC peering stability (owner: Samir) due: 2026-04-09 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3456
- T2: On‑prem orchestration fallback (owner: Anna) due: 2026-04-06 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3457
- T3: Isolation runbook + regression tests (owner: Taylor) due: 2026-04-13 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3458
- T4: Interim customer mitigations + comms (owner: Diane) due: 2026-04-05 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3459
```

Samir (eng-sre): added initial artifacts to RD-3456: packet captures + BGP dump snippets. sample log:
```
[2026-03-30T22:14:03Z] peer 10.0.8.1 state DOWN reason: hold-timer expired
[2026-03-30T22:14:03Z] session flapped 3x in 60s
config-diff: remove unused static route 192.168.50.0/24
```

Anna (eng-platform): noted. I'll wire a small orchestrator hook: `--fallback-mode=local-kv` and a unit test that simulates peering blackhole. Will link RD-3457 PR once green.

Diane (customer-success): customer confirmed they'll accept the maintenance window. Also requested rollback plan details before maintenance.

Samir (eng-sre): I'll add an automated health check + rollback play to RD-3456 and attach the alerting rule: `if peer_down > 2m then page SRE`.

Taylor (eng-runtime): I've created the runbook skeleton in RD-3458 — please add step-by-step remediation and TL;DR for on-call. Also adding a recurring weekly check-in until all tickets are closed: Wednesdays 15:00 UTC.

Jordan-CS (deploy-bot): status update: rollback artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/rollback/bluestone/vpc-peering-2026-04-07.tar.gz. Manual DNS flip documented at https://docs.redwood/internal/peering/rollback.

Diane (customer-success): I'll send the pre-maintenance note and include the rollback steps and contact list.

Taylor (eng-runtime): closing note — priority is: 1) reduce customer impact (Diane/Samir), 2) ship fallback (Anna), 3) harden tests + runbook (Taylor). If anyone is blocked, ping me directly. :calendar:
